slides.eyebrow: No one talks about this, but...
slides.sub: Plus a bakery that started in 1910. Swipe for 3 Hoboken bakeries to try.

slides.title: Carlo's Bakery
slides.body: It opened on Adams Street in 1910 and moved to Washington Street in the 1990s. Known for cannoli and lobster tails.

slides.title: Otok Bakery
slides.body: It's in the old Dom's Bakery space and still bakes in the same coal-fired oven, which is over 120 years old.

slides.title: Old German Bakery
slides.body: Traditional German breads, pretzels and tarts, right on Washington Street.

slides.title: Your Hoboken bakery walk
slides.tip: Touring homes in Hoboken? Check the walk to Hoboken Terminal for NJ Transit and PATH.

caption:
No one talks about this, but one Hoboken bakery still bakes in a coal-fired oven that's over 120 years old.
Carlo's has been around since 1910.
Old German Bakery is right on Washington Street too.
Which one are you trying first?
